review.assessment:
The change replaces the stub implementation with a complete validator that splits on `.`, enforces exactly four segments, restricts each segment to 1–3 ASCII digits without leading zeros (except `"0"`), and verifies the parsed value is ≤ 255. This correctly captures all requirements for canonical dotted-decimal IPv4 addresses.

Findings: none
